sourceKind: secondary compilation (Tax Foundation 2026 table, one row per state) with official spot checks and overrides for 2026 legislation enacted after the table date

source.title: State Individual Income Tax Rates and Brackets, 2026

shape: brackets[].overMarriedJoint is the lower bound of taxable income at which ratePercent starts, same convention as overSingle in the single-filer file (a first bracket above 0 means income below it is untaxed). Deductions/exemptions are {amount, form: 'deduction'|'credit'} or null when the state has none (Tax Foundation 'n.a.'). Local income taxes are excluded.
estimateRule: estimate:true where Tax Foundation carried a 2025 indexed figure into 2026 (its notes j, n, ll), or where a 2026 change left a figure unconfirmed.
laterChanges2026: Five states enacted 2026 rate cuts retroactive to January 1, 2026 after the table date: AR (3.7% top), GA (4.99%, $30,000 MFJ deduction), SC (1.99%/5.21%, SCIAD), UT (4.45%), WV (2.11%-4.58%). These rows use the new law. Hawaii's Act 24 (2026) changes brackets from tax year 2027 only.
